SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱2,638,000 – ₱2,738,000 (Varies by transmission and configuration)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,675 × 1,825 × 1,415 Wheelbase (mm): 2,720 Seating Capacity: 5
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
2.0 L 4-Cylinder Turbocharged Gasoline (GDi)
Maximum Output: 276 hp (up to ~286 hp with boost feature) Maximum Torque: 392 Nm
Transmission: 6-speed Manual or 8-speed Wet Dual-Clutch (DCT) Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD)
Performance (0–100 km/h): ~5.3 seconds (DCT)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Not officially rated; designed primarily for performance, not towing
Payload Capacity: Approx. 400–500 kg (typical sedan-class passenger + cargo load)
Fuel Tank Capacity: 50–55 L (varies slightly by market)
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5
Infotainment: Large touchscreen with Apple CarPlay / Android Auto Speakers: 6–8 (depending on variant)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: High-performance ventilated disc brakes
Suspension: MacPherson Strut front, Multi-Link rear (sport-tuned for N model)
Tires / Wheels: 19” Alloy Wheels with performance-grade tires
